# Kdp.Cool

> Free, fast, no-signup financial calculators and original guides. Each calculator runs in the browser and shows its math.

## Calculators on this site

- [Mortgage calculator](/mortgage-calculator/): monthly principal and interest, plus a simple tax and insurance draft.
- [Paycheck calculator](/paycheck-calculator/): federal brackets, FICA, optional flat state tax, and pretax deductions.
- [Income tax calculator](/income-tax-calculator/): 2026 US federal ordinary brackets from IRS Revenue Procedure 2025-32.

## Related finance tools

- [Auto loan calculator](https://calc.kdp.cool/auto-loan-calculator/)
- [Compound interest calculator](https://calc.kdp.cool/compound-interest-calculator/)
